title: Systematic Theology II: Humanity, Sin, Christ and Salvation
description: The second systematic theology course covers theological anthropology (the image of God, body and soul, gender), hamartiology (the fall, original sin, the bondage of the will), Christology (the person of Christ, the incarnation, the two natures, the states and offices of Christ), the atonement (its theories and extent), and soteriology (calling, regeneration, faith, justification, sanctification, perseverance). Disputed questions - such as original sin, free will, the extent of the atonement and perseverance - are presented from each tradition's own sources.
